The game has been completely abandoned. It was a fun little indie project I initially picked up after seeing it on Imgur years ago, and updated at a decent pace, then slowly the updates stopped coming. Little by little, there were only blog updates that trickled in, and now nothing the past few years.

The game is actually good and fun to play, with a bit of jank and some issues here and there, but that won't be going away since development has stopped. Even looking at the blog posts, some links are now broken, with the official website being dead, and even giving a virus warning if you attempt to access it.

I advise staying away.
